comments.author: RvZ
comments.body: This one are only used for certain quests, like Celtic

comments.author: Teyla
comments.body:
Okay, that sucks. Thanks for your answer though.
So the skill is required for some quests? Would I be able to do the quest without it, like is usually the case with other languages?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
While normally true, certain quests will not let you ignore the language requirements shown -- if your quest says it requires Latin, Ancient Egyptian, Celtic, or Hebrew, there is likely no way around needing that particular language skill to progress in the quest.

For this reason, having an aide with one or more of those language skills, or using translation notes which briefly grant the necessary language skill(s) is highly recommended so your limited skill slots can be reserved for skills you will use on a more regular basis.

Cheers.
